lines.text: Hello, Adam. This is Nadia. I have good news. We would like to offer you the position of Customer Service Agent. Congratulations!
Really? Thank you! Thank you so much! I accept!
Wonderful. We'll send you the job offer by email. Your training starts on the first of next month. Welcome to the team!
You got the job? My son got the job!
A few weeks ago, I asked you, "What's next?" Now I know the answer. I'm proud of you, son.
And I'm proud of me. I was the interviewer!
A call center? Good, good. You know, my neighbor's son…
Sami, I did it! Thank you. I couldn't do it without you.
No, you did it. I only showed you the way. You did the hard work.
The graduation… the rejection… the weeks of practice… and today. Failure isn't the end. It's a lesson.
But next month, I'll talk to real customers… in English. Am I ready for that?

options: the position of Customer Service Agent

questions.q: Where is Adam when Nadia calls?
questions.a: He is at the supermarket with his mother.
The position of Customer Service Agent.

questions.q: What does Dad say about his question "What's next?"
questions.a: He says, "Now I know the answer. I'm proud of you, son."
Because he starts talking about his neighbor's son again.

questions.q: What important thing did Adam learn?
questions.a: Failure isn't the end. It's a lesson.

questions.q: What is a lesson you learned from a mistake?
questions.a: Example: I was late for an important meeting, and I learned to always leave early.
